import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top Products by Revenue
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
colors1 = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(product_revenue))
product_revenue.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=colors1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Products by Revenue', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group and Payment Method
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_payment = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'payment_method'])['total'].sum().unstack()
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_payment = age_payment.reindex(age_order)
age_payment.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, stacked=False, width=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sales by Age Group and Payment Method', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='Payment Method', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xticklabels(ax2.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Dine-in vs Takeaway Revenue by Size
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df['service_type'] = df['is_takeaway'].map({0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'})
size_service = df.groupby(['size', 'service_type'])['total'].sum().unstack()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_service = size_service.reindex(size_order)
x = np.arange(len(size_order))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax3.bar(x - width/2, size_service['Dine-in'], width, label='Dine-in', color='#3498db')
bars2 = ax3.bar(x + width/2, size_service['Takeaway'], width, label='Takeaway', color='#e74c3c')
ax3.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Revenue by Product Size and Service Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.set_xticks(x)
ax3.set_xticklabels(size_order)
ax3.legend(fontsize=10)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Average Transaction Value by Hour
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time'], format='%H:%M').dt.hour
hourly_avg = df.groupby('hour')['total'].mean()
ax4.plot(hourly_avg.index, hourly_avg.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, 
         markersize=6, color='#2ecc71', markerfacecolor='#27ae60', markeredgewidth=1.5)
ax4.fill_between(hourly_avg.index, hourly_avg.values, alpha=0.3, color='#2ecc71')
ax4.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Average Transaction Value Throughout the Day', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
